<a id="economy"></a>

## Economy: economy (ECON)

An economy: output, growth, prices, jobs, debt and external balance, and output by sector, from World Bank, IMF and CIA data. One row per economy, keyed by ECONOMY_ID. Read by the **world-economy** pack's connector `macro-store` (lake table `macro.economy`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`modules/economy/packs/world-economy/samples/economy.jsonl`, 213 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

### File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `modules/economy/packs/world-economy/samples/economy.jsonl` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line |
| Key field | `ECONOMY_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the pack's samples are served on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | `NAME`, `ISO3`, `REGION_NAME`, `INCOME_NAME`, `GDP_USD_BN`, `GDP_PER_CAPITA`, `GROWTH`, `INFLATION`, `UNEMPLOYMENT`, `POPULATION_M` |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

### Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ECONOMY_ID` | string | required | The record's id (the business key) | pattern `^ECON-` | `"ECON-AFG"` |
| `NAME` | string | required | The country or territory, with the name the World Bank uses. | — | `"Afghanistan"` |
| `ISO3` | string | required | The country's ISO 3166 alpha-3 code. | — | `"AFG"` |
| `REGION_NAME` | string | required | The World Bank geographic region the economy belongs to. | one of `East Asia & Pacific`, `Europe & Central Asia`, `Latin America & Caribbean`, `Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan`, `North America`, `South Asia`, `Sub-Saharan Africa` | `"Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan"` |
| `INCOME_NAME` | string | required | The World Bank income group (High income, Upper middle income, Lower middle income, Low income). | one of `High income`, `Low income`, `Lower middle income`, `Upper middle income` | `"Low income"` |
| `CURRENCY` | string | optional (filled in 91% of rows) | The currency code as the source gives it. | — | `"AFA"` |
| `CAPITAL` | string | optional (filled in 98% of rows) | The capital city's name, from the CIA World Factbook. | — | `"Kabul"` |
| `YEAR` | string | required | The year of the headline figures. | seen: `2025`, `2024`, `2022`, `2023`, `2015`, `2018`, `2020`, `2021` | `"2024"` |
| `GDP_USD_BN` | number | required | The value of all goods and services produced in the economy in a year, in current US dollars at market exchange rates. | unit: USD billions | `17.7785` |
| `GDP_PER_CAPITA` | number | required | GDP divided by the mid-year population, in current US dollars. | unit: USD | `416.871` |
| `GROWTH` | number | optional (filled in over 99% of rows) | The yearly change of GDP after removing inflation, so it measures the growth of output rather than of prices. | unit: % a year | `1.87319` |
| `INFLATION` | number | optional (filled in 89% of rows) | The yearly change of consumer prices (the consumer price index). | unit: % a year | `-6.60119` |

### Fields in other rows

None: all 213 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

### For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `ECONOMY_ID` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `ECONOMY_ID`, `NAME`, `ISO3`, `REGION_NAME`, `INCOME_NAME`, `YEAR`, `GDP_USD_BN`, `GDP_PER_CAPITA`, `POPULATION_M`, `GROWTH_PATH`, `GDP_PATH`, `SECTORS`, `REGION_GROUP`, `INCOME_GROUP`, `INDICATORS`, `PROVENANCE` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `ECONOMY_ID` per snapshot.
- `ECONOMY_ID` matches `^ECON-`.

<a id="macro-indicator"></a>

## Macro indicator: macro-indicator (MACRO)

One headline statistic of one economy: the series, the latest value, the change and the rank among economies. One row per macro indicator, keyed by INDICATOR_ID. Read by the **world-economy** pack's connector `macro-store` (lake table `macro.macro-indicator`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`modules/economy/packs/world-economy/samples/macro-indicator.jsonl`, 3119 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

### File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `modules/economy/packs/world-economy/samples/macro-indicator.jsonl` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line |
| Key field | `INDICATOR_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the pack's samples are served on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | none (the whole record is kept as `doc`) |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

### For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `INDICATOR_ID` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `INDICATOR_ID`, `NAME`, `INDICATOR`, `COUNTRY_NAME`, `UNIT`, `DEFINITION`, `LATEST`, `LATEST_YEAR`, `HISTORY`, `FACTS`, `ECONOMY`, `PROVENANCE` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `INDICATOR_ID` per snapshot.
- `INDICATOR_ID` matches `^MACRO-`.
- `OF_COUNT` is at least 0.

<a id="economic-forecast"></a>

## Economic forecast: economic-forecast (FCST)

The IMF World Economic Outlook: growth, inflation, unemployment, external balance and debt, outturn and projections to 2031. One row per economic forecast, keyed by FORECAST_ID. Read by the **world-economy** pack's connector `macro-store` (lake table `macro.economic-forecast`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`modules/economy/packs/world-economy/samples/economic-forecast.jsonl`, 192 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

### File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `modules/economy/packs/world-economy/samples/economic-forecast.jsonl` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line |
| Key field | `FORECAST_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the pack's samples are served on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | none (the whole record is kept as `doc`) |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

### One sample record

| `PROVENANCE.ATTRIBUTION` | string | required | The credit line to repeat when the data is shown or republished. | — | `"Source: International Monetary Fund, World Economic Outloo…` |
| `PROVENANCE.URL` | string | required | The web page of the dataset. | — | `"https://www.imf.org/external/datamapper"` |

### For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `FISCAL_ID` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.

- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `FISCAL_ID` per snapshot.
- `FISCAL_ID` matches `^FISC-`.

<a id="region-economy"></a>

## Region economy: region-economy (REGE)

A state or territory (ISO 3166-2): population, GDP and GDP per head. One row per region economy, keyed by REGION_ID. Read by the **world-economy** pack's connector `macro-store` (lake table `macro.region-economy`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`modules/economy/packs/world-economy/samples/region-economy.jsonl`, 59 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

### File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `modules/economy/packs/world-economy/samples/region-economy.jsonl` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line |
| Key field | `REGION_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the pack's samples are served on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | `ISO3`, `COUNTRY_NAME`, `REGION_CODE`, `NAME`, `POPULATION`, `GDP_USD_BN`, `GDP_PER_CAPITA`, `YEAR`, `SOURCE` |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

<a id="jurisdiction"></a>

## Jurisdiction: jurisdiction (JUR)

A country: government type, capital, legislature and seats by party, office holders, elections and governance indicators, from the CIA World Factbook, World Bank and UNDP. One row per jurisdiction, keyed by JURISDICTION_ID. Read by the **world-economy** pack's connector `civic-store` (lake table `civic.jurisdiction`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`modules/economy/packs/world-economy/samples/jurisdiction.jsonl`, 216 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

### File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `modules/economy/packs/world-economy/samples/jurisdiction.jsonl` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line |
| Key field | `JURISDICTION_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the pack's samples are served on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | none (the whole record is kept as `doc`) |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

### For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `JURISDICTION_ID` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `JURISDICTION_ID`, `NAME`, `ISO3`, `OFFICIAL_NAME`, `REGION_NAME`, `POPULATION_M`, `LEGISLATURE`, `INDICATORS`, `PARTIES_LISTED`, `PROFILE`, `REGION`, `ELECTIONS`, `PARTIES`, `SOCIAL_INDICATORS`, `PROVENANCE` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `JURISDICTION_ID` per snapshot.
- `JURISDICTION_ID` matches `^JUR-`.

<a id="party"></a>

## Party: party (PARTY)

A political party that won seats in the lower chamber at the most recent election, with the chamber's full result. One row per party, keyed by PARTY_ID. Read by the **world-economy** pack's connector `civic-store` (lake table `civic.party`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`modules/economy/packs/world-economy/samples/party.jsonl`, 282 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

### File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `modules/economy/packs/world-economy/samples/party.jsonl` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line |
| Key field | `PARTY_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the pack's samples are served on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | none (the whole record is kept as `doc`) |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

### One sample record

A real record, the most complete of the 282 (the one with the most non-empty fields), pretty-printed with two-space indents. **A string such as `"… 506 more numbers"` inside an array marks a fold**: it stands for the elements left out and is not part of the data.

  "PARTY_ID": "PARTY-ARG-01",
  "NAME": "Union for the Homeland (UP)",

  "SEATS": 48,
  "SEAT_SHARE": 37.5,
  "CHAMBER": "Chamber of Deputies (Cámara de Diputados)",
  "RANK": 1,
  "TOTAL_SEATS": 128,
  "ELECTION_DATE": "10/22/2023",
  "RESULTS": [
    {
      "PARTY": "Union for the Homeland (UP)",
      "SEATS": 48,
      "SHARE": 37.5
    },
    {
      "PARTY": "Freedom Advances (LLA)",
      "SEATS": 28,
      "SHARE": 21.9
    },
    "… 2 more elements of the same shape"
  ],
  "ELECTION": "ELEC-ARG-LOW",
  "JURISDICTION": "JUR-ARG",
  "PROVENANCE": {
    "SOURCE": "CIA, The World Factbook (factbook.json mirror, CC0)",

A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

<a id="election"></a>

## Election: election (ELEC)

The most recent election to a chamber or to the executive, with the system, term, seats by party and the date of the next one. One row per election, keyed by ELECTION_ID. Read by the **world-economy** pack's connector `civic-store` (lake table `civic.election`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`modules/economy/packs/world-economy/samples/election.jsonl`, 378 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

### File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `modules/economy/packs/world-economy/samples/election.jsonl` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line |
| Key field | `ELECTION_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the pack's samples are served on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | none (the whole record is kept as `doc`) |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

## World region: region (REGN)

A World Bank region: its countries, population, life expectancy, women in parliament, Internet use and the government types found in it. One row per world region, keyed by REGION_ID. Read by the **world-economy** pack's connector `civic-store` (lake table `civic.region`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`modules/economy/packs/world-economy/samples/region.jsonl`, 7 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

<a id="social-indicator"></a>

## Social indicator: social-indicator (SOCI)

A social or governance statistic of one country over time, with the regional comparison: health, education, inequality, rights and rule of law. One row per social indicator, keyed by INDICATOR_ID. Read by the **world-economy** pack's connector `civic-store` (lake table `civic.social-indicator`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`modules/economy/packs/world-economy/samples/social-indicator.jsonl`, 4297 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

### File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `modules/economy/packs/world-economy/samples/social-indicator.jsonl` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line |
| Key field | `INDICATOR_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the pack's samples are served on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | none (the whole record is kept as `doc`) |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

### One sample record

A real record, the most complete of the 4,297 (the one with the most non-empty fields), pretty-printed with two-space indents. **A string such as `"… 506 more numbers"` inside an array marks a fold**: it stands for the elements left out and is not part of the data.

  "INDICATOR_ID": "SOCI-ABW-EDUCATION-SPEND",

    {
      "YEAR": "2015",
      "VALUE": 5.88827
    },
    {
      "YEAR": "2016",
      "VALUE": 5.49136
    },
    "… 4 more elements of the same shape"
  ],
  "BY_REGION": [
    {
      "COUNTRY": "Cuba",
      "VALUE": 8.44086
    },
    {
      "COUNTRY": "Bolivia",
      "VALUE": 7.5398
    },
    "… 8 more elements of the same shape"
  ],
  "REGION_NAME": "Latin America & Caribbean",

    "LICENCE": "CC BY 4.0",

### Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `INDICATOR_ID` | string | required | The record's id (the business key) | pattern `^SOCI-` | `"SOCI-ABW-EDUCATION-SPEND"` |
| `NAME` | string | required | The country and the statistic. | — | `"Aruba · Government expenditure on education"` |
| `INDICATOR` | string | required | The indicator's name as published (Government expenditure on education). | — | `"Government expenditure on education"` |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | string | required | The country's name (Aruba). | — | `"Aruba"` |
| `THEME` | string | required | The theme of the indicator (Society or Governance). | one of `Governance`, `Society` | `"Society"` |
| `LATEST` | number | required | The most recent published value. | — | `3.61856` |
| `LATEST_YEAR` | string | required | The year of the latest value. | — | `"2021"` |
| `UNIT` | string | required | What the value measures. | — | `"% of GDP"` |
| `CHANGE_5Y` | number | optional (filled in 94% of rows) | The latest value minus the value about five years earlier. | — | `-1.8728` |
| `SOURCE_NAME` | string | required | The dataset the series comes from. | one of `UNDP, Human Development Report: composite indices time series`, `World Bank, World Development Indicators`, `World Bank, Worldwide Governance Indicators` | `"World Bank, World Development Indicators"` |
| `DEFINITION` | string | required | The source's definition of the indicator. | — | `"General government spending on education, as a share of GD…` |
| `SERIES` | array of objects | required | The indicator by year, oldest first, one element per year: YEAR (text) and VALUE in the unit of MEANING.UNIT. | — | [6 objects] |
| `SERIES[].YEAR` | string | required | The calendar year of the value, as four-digit text ("2015"). | — | `"2015"` |
| `SERIES[].VALUE` | number | required | The published value in that year. | — | `5.88827` |
| `BY_REGION` | array of objects | required | The latest value for the countries of the same region, one element per country: COUNTRY (its name) and VALUE. | — | [10 objects] |
| `BY_REGION[].COUNTRY` | string | required | The country, from the same World Bank region. | — | `"Cuba"` |
| `BY_REGION[].VALUE` | number | required | The latest value (2022 or later) for that country. | — | `8.44086` |
| `REGION_NAME` | string | required | The World Bank region of the country, for the regional comparison. | one of `East Asia & Pacific`, `Europe & Central Asia`, `Latin America & Caribbean`, `Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan`, `North America`, `South Asia`, `Sub-Saharan Africa` | `"Latin America & Caribbean"` |
| `JURISDICTION` | string | required | The country: an id of the jurisdiction kind (JUR-<ISO3>). | pattern `^JUR-`; links to `jurisdiction` | `"JUR-ABW"` |
| `PROVENANCE` | object | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE (World Bank WDI or WGI, or UNDP), DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION and URL. | — | {…} |
| `PROVENANCE.SOURCE` | string | required | The organisation or organisations whose published data this view shows. | one of `UNDP, Human Development Report: composite indices time series`, `World Bank, World Development Indicators`, `World Bank, Worldwide Governance Indicators` | `"World Bank, World Development Indicators"` |
| `PROVENANCE.DATASET` | string | required | The named dataset and its vintage (the release the numbers come from). | one of `Human Development Index time series (2025 report)`, `World Development Indicators (updated 2026-10-08)`, `Worldwide Governance Indicators (updated 2026-09-25)` | `"World Development Indicators (updated 2026-10-08)"` |
| `PROVENANCE.RETRIEVED_AT` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The date the data was downloaded by tools/realdata. | — | `"2026-10-10"` |
| `PROVENANCE.LICENCE` | string | required | The terms under which the source allows reuse; attribution is required. | one of `CC BY 3.0 IGO`, `CC BY 4.0` | `"CC BY 4.0"` |
| `PROVENANCE.ATTRIBUTION` | string | required | The credit line to repeat when the data is shown or republished. | one of `The World Bank: World Development Indicators (CC BY 4.0).`, `The World Bank: Worldwide Governance Indicators (CC BY 4.0).`, `UNDP, Human Development Report 2025 data (CC BY 3.0 IGO).` | `"The World Bank: World Development Indicators (CC BY 4.0)."` |
| `PROVENANCE.URL` | string | required | The web page of the dataset. | one of `https://databank.worldbank.org/source/world-development-indicators`, `https://hdr.undp.org/data-center/documentation-and-downloads`, `https://www.worldbank.org/en/publication/worldwide-governance-indicators` | `"https://databank.worldbank.org/source/world-development-in…` |
| `_meta` | object | optional (filled in every row) | The generator's provenance stamp, one object; optional, carried through in the stored document and not read by Drishti (the contracts leave it out). A bank's extract may omit it. | — | {…} |
| `_meta.source` | string | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The source system or public source the record was built from (sec-edgar, gleif, …). | seen: `World Bank, World Development Indicators`, `World Bank, Worldwide Governance Indicators`, `UNDP, Human Development Report: composite indices time series` | `"World Bank, World Development Indicators"` |
| `_meta.dataset` | string | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The source's data set the record was read from. | seen: `World Development Indicators (updated 2026-10-08)`, `Worldwide Governance Indicators (updated 2026-09-25)`, `Human Development Index time series (2025 report)` | `"World Development Indicators (updated 2026-10-08)"` |
| `_meta.retrievedAt` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The date the source data was retrieved, YYYY-MM-DD. | — | `"2026-10-10"` |
| `_meta.licence` | string | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The licence of the source data. | seen: `CC BY 4.0`, `CC BY 3.0 IGO` | `"CC BY 4.0"` |
| `_meta.generation` | integer | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The generator's format generation (always 1). | — | `1` |
| `MEANING` | object | required | What the indicator means, one object: INDICATOR, UNIT (% of GDP, births per woman …), DEFINITION and COMPARED_WITH (the region the country is compared with). | — | {…} |
| `MEANING.INDICATOR` | string | required | The indicator's name, the same as INDICATOR. | — | `"Government expenditure on education"` |
| `MEANING.UNIT` | string | required | What the value measures. | — | `"% of GDP"` |
| `MEANING.DEFINITION` | string | required | The source's definition of the statistic. | — | `"General government spending on education, as a share of GD…` |
| `MEANING.COMPARED_WITH` | string | required | The countries the bar chart compares with. | one of `countries of East Asia & Pacific (latest value, 2022 or later)`, `countries of Europe & Central Asia (latest value, 2022 or later)`, `countries of Latin America & Caribbean (latest value, 2022 or later)`, `countries of Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan (latest value, 2022 or later)`, `countries of North America (latest value, 2022 or later)`, `countries of South Asia (latest value, 2022 or later)`, `countries of Sub-Saharan Africa (latest value, 2022 or later)` | `"countries of Latin America & Caribbean (latest value, 2022…` |

### Fields in other rows

None: all 4,297 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

### For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `INDICATOR_ID` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `INDICATOR_ID`, `NAME`, `INDICATOR`, `COUNTRY_NAME`, `THEME`, `LATEST`, `LATEST_YEAR`, `UNIT`, `SOURCE_NAME`, `DEFINITION`, `SERIES`, `BY_REGION`, `REGION_NAME`, `JURISDICTION`, `PROVENANCE`, `MEANING` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `INDICATOR_ID` per snapshot.
- `INDICATOR_ID` matches `^SOCI-`.
